name: foxbench
description: A fixed task suite that scores browser agents in Firefox, with prompt-injection traps.
author: Pooria Arab

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.globSync('src/bench/*/*.py')) fs.cpSync(f, f.replace(/^src/, 'dist'))"
scripts.ci:local: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm build:ext && pnpm lint:ext && pnpm check:amo
scripts.e2e: pnpm build && pnpm build:ext && node e2e/run.mjs
scripts.e2e:bench: pnpm build && pnpm build:ext && node e2e/bench.mjs
